author: Avinash Saravanan
description: Machine-readable index of the 33 projects documented at /projects/. Each record mirrors the public write-up and links back to its section anchor.

fields.order: Position in the public project list, newest first.
fields.year: Project year or range as shown in the project heading.
fields.summary: Short factual summary derived from the project write-up.
fields.stack: Languages, frameworks, services, and tools stated in the write-up.
fields.links: Public source, demo, paper, or related project links.

projects.title: Langchain Chains and Agents with MERN Stack Web Application
projects.summary: Full-stack TypeScript application on the MERN stack that implements LangChain chains and ReAct-style agents with Gemini, persists chat history in MongoDB, and exposes tools including Wikipedia, a calculator, and a headless browser. Dockerized for docker-compose and Kubernetes deployment.

projects.title: Masters Thesis
projects.summary: TU Delft master's thesis designing and evaluating a conversational agent that rephrases shared experiences into motivational references to support diet-related goals for people with type II diabetes.

projects.title: Speed Reader
projects.summary: Desktop speed-reading application for improving reading speed and comprehension, written in Python and packaged as executables for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

projects.title: Teaching Tools
projects.summary: Templates, examples, and walkthroughs for teaching HTML, LaTeX, programming concepts, and Python.

projects.title: Genetic Algorithm
projects.summary: Python implementation of a genetic algorithm that approximates an input image with a limited number of colored polygons, written for an introductory AI course at the University of Michigan.

projects.title: User Styles
projects.summary: A collection of custom user styles that add dark modes and other restyling to websites, usable through browser extensions such as Stylus or Stylish.

projects.title: !This Website!
projects.summary: The personal portfolio itself: a statically generated Jekyll site with Sass, JavaScript, and Bootstrap, iterated through several major redesigns.

projects.title: MIT 6.S094 Deep Traffic
projects.summary: Solution to MIT 6.S094's DeepTraffic deep reinforcement learning competition, averaging about 66 mph against a maximum speed of 80 mph.

projects.title: Learning Arduino
projects.summary: Projects and tutorials completed with the Elegoo Uno Starter Kit, covering digital inputs, servos, a passive buzzer, and a four-digit seven-segment display.

projects.title: Learning ProcessingJS
projects.summary: ProcessingJS sketches and challenges from Khan Academy covering drawing, animation, games, and natural simulations.

projects.title: Learning ml5js
projects.summary: Projects and tutorials extending ml5.js for image classification, pitch detection, video classification, and text generation, with browser demos.

projects.title: Habit Tracker
projects.summary: In-progress habit-tracking desktop application built with Electron and Angular 7.

projects.title: IN4010-12 Artificial Intelligence Techniques
projects.summary: Graduate coursework covering Bayesian posterior probabilities, automated bilateral negotiation through TU Delft's GENIUS framework, and reinforcement learning.

projects.title: CS4070 Multivariate Data Analysis
projects.summary: Graduate data-analysis coursework covering EKG autocorrelation and maximum a posteriori estimation, Kalman filtering, Bayesian linear regression, Newton-Raphson, Metropolis-Hastings, Gibbs sampling, and Gaussian processes.

projects.title: IN4086-14 Data Visualization
projects.summary: Graduate data-visualization coursework covering d3 information visualization and volumetric rendering, coloring, and shading of 3D data.

projects.title: CS4220 Machine Learning 1
projects.summary: Machine-learning coursework exercises on training data, cross-validation, and classifiers using the PRTools pattern-recognition library.

projects.title: IN4325 Information Retrieval
projects.summary: Reproduction of two information-retrieval papers: sentiment classification with spaCy and scikit-learn, and Wikipedia table lookup using SPARQL, word2vec, and a random-forest regressor.

projects.title: CS4235 Socio-Cognitive Engineering
projects.summary: Designed a Pepper robot interaction for elder care, sensory stimulation, and cognitive exercise, including music playback through the Spotify API.

projects.title: CS4240 Deep Learning
projects.summary: Reproduction of the dropout paper for neural networks, with experiments on ImageNet and CIFAR-10 image classification.

projects.title: CS4145 Crowd Computing
projects.summary: Designed and ran crowd-sourcing tasks on Amazon Mechanical Turk for entity resolution, with Python and Pandas data processing.

projects.title: CS4065 Multimedia Search and Recommendation
projects.summary: Game recommendation system using Steam data, matrix factorization, Gaussian mixture feature fusion, and neural collaborative filtering with RecoUtils and TensorFlow, plus a D3 front end for qualitative evaluation.

projects.title: Basic Stock Prediction
projects.summary: Ongoing pipeline that predicts a stock's future value from past data using scikit-learn and the yFinance API, with a Streamlit interface available on request.

projects.title: CS4205 Evolutionary Algorithms
projects.summary: Implementation and analysis of evolutionary algorithms including genetic algorithms, GOMEA variants, AMaLGaM, NSGA-II, and evolutionary programming on max-cut, sphere, rotated-ellipsoid, and multi-objective problems.

projects.title: IN4334 Machine Learning for Software Engineering
projects.summary: Applied BERT to story-point estimation using Jira data from public Apache and Mulesoft servers, incorporating team dynamics through a sliding window and comparing against a recurrent highway network baseline.

projects.title: CS4270 Conversational Agents
projects.summary: Furhat robot interaction teaching the basic math concept of division, with affect detection, gestures, gaze, and dialogue.

projects.title: Deep Learning Based Video Upscaling
projects.summary: Video upscaling with convolutional neural networks trained on downscaled images, applied frame by frame and reassembled at the original frame rate.

projects.title: CS4165 Social Signal Processing
projects.summary: Study of prosodic entrainment and memory when participants interact with human-faced versus robot-faced tutors, using Furhat, Pydub, Parselmouth, and statistical tests; the work led to an ACM Multimedia workshop publication.

projects.title: Pytorch Refresher
projects.summary: Collection of PyTorch scripts for refreshing deep-learning fundamentals, including deep Q-learning on CartPole and Acrobot, feed-forward networks on MNIST-family datasets, a CIFAR-10 CNN, RNN name generation and classification, and an FGSM tutorial.

projects.title: Learning Tableau
projects.summary: Tableau dashboards and sheets built from public datasets using Tableau Public 2022.1.

projects.title: Conway's Game of Life
projects.summary: Browser implementation of Conway's Game of Life in HTML, JavaScript, and CSS.

projects.title: Dreaming of a Hopeful Death
projects.summary: Visual-novel adaptation of the novel of the same name, with DALL-E 2 generated images and dialogue written in Python using the Ren'Py engine.

projects.title: Text to Video Generation
projects.summary: Text-to-video generation with ModelScope, followed by Video2x upscaling and denoising as part of a collaborative pipeline.

projects.title: Nextjs Frontend with Routing and APIs
projects.summary: Next.js and TypeScript frontend with routing and APIs built by following Vercel's tutorial, hosted on Vercel with a Neon Postgres database.
